text:
maria: FYI: release pipeline is red on regen diffs for the TypeScript SDK. CI failed the semver gate.
alex: ugh, can you paste the CI error? is this the openapi/codegen step?
maria: yeah, here — Buildkite job 7123
buildkite: [buildkite] ERROR: semver-check failed: spec version bump detected (1.3.2 -> 2.0.0)
buildkite: To publish a patch/minor release, spec must be backwards compatible.
sam: Which spec change caused it? any specific endpoint diff?
maria: quick grep shows diff in openapi.yaml — /chat/messages now has required property `user_id`
jonathan: that is a breaking change for sure. who merged that? @marc?
marc: that was me, I updated the endpoint to require user_id for auditing. I forgot to open a major-version PR or add a changelog note.
alex: we need to decide fast: revert the change (so we can ship the patch) or bump major and update changelog + SDK typegen.
sam: Reverting is safest for this patch release. We can schedule a major with the audit change later.
marc: will revert and open a follow-up RFC for audit enforcement.
maria: note — the CI also flagged typegen diffs in packages/sdk-ts/src/types.ts
maria: diff snippet:
```
-  user_id?: string
+  user_id: string
```
sam: that's expected given the spec change. typegen run will propagate.
alex: also: while we're here, can we fix inconsistent auth/retry behavior? Go SDK still retries 401 differently than TS.
jonathan: good catch. SDK parity issue — we should add a test to regen pipeline that checks auth+retry contract across SDKs.
marc: agree, but separate change. for this release I'll revert and run `./bin/regen-openapi --skip-semver` locally to confirm.
maria: please don't use --skip-semver in CI. We need to keep the gate.
marc: understood.
alex: who's owning the changelog entry when we eventually ship the major? I can draft one: "audit: chat.messages user_id required; affects clients — bump to v2"
sam: also record migration guidance: how to populate user_id when proxying tokens.
maria: action items:
- marc: revert the openapi change and push a hotfix PR (owner)
- alex: add a regendiff test that fails CI if SDKs diverge on auth/retry semantics (owner)
- jonathan: create changelog template for major API bumps (owner)
- sam: add migration note for audit requirement (owner)
marc: pushing revert now. running local regen...`yarn regen:openapi` -> will open PR in ~10m
maria: thanks. once PR is up, I'll kick a fresh release run and monitor buildkite.
alex: ok, and let's log this in the release notes channel after we decide the approach. :memo:
buildkite: [buildkite] INFO: job queued by maria
sam: small follow-up: can we make the regen diffs more human-friendly? current diff spam makes it hard to spot semver-impacting changes.
jonathan: idea: have the regen step emit a short summary: which endpoints added/removed/required-flag-changes, plus a combined semver impact hint.
maria: love that. filing a ticket in devex backlog.
marc: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/openapi/pull/428 (revert)
maria: merging after CI green. thanks all :thumbsup:
